Hi There! 👋🏻😃

Welcome to *Online Onward Tickets*. How can I help you?

Please choose an option to move ahead ⏩

✈️ You can book your flight reservation online in a few minutes:

1️⃣ Choose flight, hotel or both (one-way, round trip or multi-trip)
2️⃣ Enter route and dates
3️⃣ Add passenger names exactly as on the passport + your email, and choose validity (24–48 hours, 7 days or 14 days)
4️⃣ Pay online (card, PayPal or Razorpay)
5️⃣ Receive your reservation with booking code (PNR) by email in 10–60 minutes

👉 Book here: https://onlineonwardtickets.com/book

config.text:
🌐 It comes with a *valid PNR (booking code)* which can be verified on the airline website, using your PNR and last name.

Note: the lookup depends on the airline and on the time of your check.

🪪 It is a flight reservation, so it can be attached wherever a flight reservation / itinerary is asked.

Please refer to your visa 📃 checklist: if it asks for a flight reservation, this is what you need. Many visas ask for it, like the Schengen 🇪🇺 visa.

Requirements differ by country and embassy, and we cannot guarantee acceptance by third parties.

🎟 *Validity options* (choose when you order):

• 24–48 hours: included in the price
• Up to 7 days: +$6 per passenger
• Up to 14 days: +$12 per passenger

Which validity do you need? 👇

config.text:
⏳ *24–48 hours* validity is included in the price (flight from $18 per passenger).

Need it to last longer? You can also pick *up to 7 days* (+$6) or *up to 14 days* (+$12) on the booking page.

Full details: https://onlineonwardtickets.com/validity-policy

⏳ *Up to 7 days* validity costs *+$6 per passenger* on top of the base price. Example: one-way flight $18 + $6 = $24 per passenger.

Choose it on the booking page 👉 https://onlineonwardtickets.com/book

⏳ *Up to 14 days* validity costs *+$12 per passenger* on top of the base price. Example: one-way flight $18 + $12 = $30 per passenger. This is the longest validity a reservation can have.

Choose it on the booking page 👉 https://onlineonwardtickets.com/book

✈️ A reservation can stay valid for *14 days at most*.

If you need validity *beyond 14 days, or valid until your flight lands*, please take our *cancellable flight ticket* instead. It is a confirmed ticket with a live PNR and an e-ticket number, so it stays valid until your flight date.

The price depends on your route, so our team will share it with you.

🛄 Let us explain:

*Flight reservation* (our regular product): comes with a live PNR but *not* with an e-ticket number. $18 per passenger. It is not a paid ticket and cannot be used for boarding, and acceptance at immigration cannot be guaranteed.

*Cancellable flight ticket*: comes with a live PNR *and* an e-ticket number. It is a confirmed ticket which stays valid until your flight date, so it is the right choice if you need validity beyond 14 days. The price depends on the route, so our team will share it with you.

More info: https://onlineonwardtickets.com/faq
